---
title: "ExDyn Sandbox: First Run"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("exdyn.sandbox", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    pkgload::load_all(export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop("exdyn.sandbox package is not available and pkgload is missing.")
  }
} else {
  library(exdyn.sandbox)
}
library(targets)
store_path <- if (dir.exists("../_targets")) "../_targets" else "_targets"
tar_load(c(default_N, default_po, default_foss, default_summs, cfg), store = store_path)
total <- apply(default_N, 3, sum)
```

## Total abundance through time

```{r}
plot(total, type="l", xlab="Year", ylab="Total abundance")
```

## Presence-only vs fossil samples (counts)

```{r}
table(default_po$t)[1:10]
nrow(default_foss)
```
